name: Isshiki Kaname
source:
[b]The Aristocratic Leader: Japan's Shadow Ruler, Elite Academy's Queen[/b]

Meet the Student Council President of Ougen Academy - Kaname, heir to a noble Isshiki lineage whose aristocratic roots stretch back to the Meiji era. She's every bit the blue blood, ruling the roost in her final year.

When her parents' passing made her head of the family, she stepped up like she'd been doing it all her life. No surprise there - she's been groomed for greatness since day one.

Steel and ice in public, she keeps everyone at arm's length with her perfect poker face. But around the Houjou sisters, who grew up serving at her side? That's when you might catch a glimpse of her sweeter side.

"Worry not. Be you from Sugara District or elsewhere - we have but one purpose."

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://selectoblige.com/character]official website[/url]]
